title: 第6899章 成功过劫第6898章 剑匣助力
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 原本幸灾乐祸的阴天子等人，全部都瞠目结舌的望着面前所发生的一切。
万万没有想到，孙冰竟然还有这等底牌。
尤其是那剑匣，看起来丝毫不起眼，似乎仅仅只是安置神剑的匣子。
但正是这不起眼的东西，竟然能够抗住维度大劫。
难不成这乃是一件混沌至宝？
只不过这个念头刚刚出现在祂们脑海，便被立刻摇头否决了。
毕竟混沌级别的宝物，诸天唯一。
拥有着无比超然的力量。
目光落在其身上，脑海中便会浮现出相对应的名字，以及大概功能。
因为这等宝物，根本就不需要隐藏。
纵然一切都暴露在敌人的目光下，依旧无敌。
反观那剑匣，无论祂们再怎么竭尽全力的查探，都未曾获得任何消息。
显然，这乃是一件超出了祂们认知的宝物。
正当地府诸多至强者脑海中思绪万千的时候，滚滚维度洪流疯狂汇集，再次凝练出最后一道雷霆落下。
当那紫色的高维雷光出现时，便已经与先前四道雷霆的高维道韵产生了共鸣。
毫不夸张的说，这一道雷霆的威能可以轻易覆灭一个完整的混沌。
当那雷光出现后，诸如阴天子，六大鬼王，十方鬼帝的背后都充满着凉意。
因为在这等力量之下，祂们着实感受到了致命的危机。
值得庆幸的是，如今这股力量所针对的乃是青萍剑。
否则根本就不需要孙冰出手，单单这股余波都能够摧毁整个混沌。
终究，那紫色的雷霆直接落下。
高维力量席卷四方，完全超越了时间，空间，因果，命运，妄图强行跨越一切，从而针对青萍剑。
但一直以来没有任何动静的剑匣，却绽放出了淡淡的荧光。
随即，更是强行终止了雷光的动作，硬生生通过自己的身躯挡住了那狂暴的力量。
这一刻的剑匣横在高维与低维之间。
任由滚滚维度洪流汹涌而来，依旧屹然不动。
而仔细观察，更能看见那剑匣的表面，无数雷龙呼啸。
紫色，血色，青色，金色等等各种各样的雷光闪烁。
剑匣就如同坠入雷海一般，历经亿万兆神雷的冲刷。
单单这番场景，就让人触目惊心。
无数生灵的背后都充满着冷汗。
至于原本地府中随处可见的阴魂，如今更是只敢蜷缩在角落瑟瑟发抖。
毕竟雷本就是天地至刚至阳的显化，更何况这乃是高维雷霆，对于阴邪的克制更是达到了极致。
即便仅仅只是其中最为细微的雷光降临，都足以覆灭这些阴魂。
所以它们只能按照自身本能退避。
而另一边，剑匣依旧在无垠的雷海之中。
时间在这一刻似乎陷入了静止。
滚滚雷光激荡，依旧在轰击着剑匣。
正当孙冰思考这一次维度大劫什么时候结束的时候，剑匣突然打开了。
如此变故立刻让其眉头微皱，一颗心也沉入了谷底。
毕竟外面那些高维雷霆，对于此时的青萍剑而言，乃是根本就无法抵挡的灾厄。
在其万分担心的时候，青萍剑竟然直接飞出。
紧接着，更是在众目睽睽下，于那高维雷海之中畅游。
content_en:
Yin Tianzi and others, who were originally gloating about their misfortune, were all dumbfounded as they looked at what was happening in front of them.
I never expected that Sun Bing would have such a trump card.
Especially the sword box, which looked inconspicuous at all, as if it was just a box to house the divine sword.
But it is this inconspicuous thing that can withstand the dimensional catastrophe.
Could it be that this is a treasure of chaos?
But as soon as this idea appeared in their minds, they were immediately rejected by shaking their heads.
After all, the treasure of the chaos level is the only one in the world.
Possessing extremely transcendent power.
When your eyes fall on it, the corresponding name and approximate function will appear in your mind.
Because there is no need to hide such treasures at all.
Even if everything is exposed to the eyes of the enemy, he is still invincible.
Looking back at the sword box, no matter how hard they tried their best to investigate, they never got any information.
Obviously, this is a treasure beyond their knowledge.
Just when many of the most powerful people in the local government were thinking a lot, the rolling dimensional torrents gathered together crazily, and once again condensed into the last thunderbolt that fell.
When the purple high-dimensional thunder light appeared, it already resonated with the high-dimensional Taoist rhyme of the previous four thunderbolts.
It is no exaggeration to say that the power of this thunder can easily destroy a complete chaos.
When the thunder light appeared, the backs of people such as Yin Tianzi, the six ghost kings, and the ghost emperors of the ten directions were filled with chills.
Because under such power, they really felt a fatal crisis.
Fortunately, this force is now aimed at Qingping Sword.
Otherwise, there would be no need for Sun Bing to take action. This aftermath alone could destroy the entire chaos.
After all, the purple thunder fell directly.
High-dimensional power sweeps across all directions, completely transcending time, space, cause and effect, and destiny, trying to forcibly transcend everything, thereby targeting Qingping Sword.
But the sword box, which had been silent all this time, started to glow with a faint fluorescence.
Immediately, he forcibly stopped the movement of lightning and blocked the violent power with his own body.
The sword box at this moment lies between high and low dimensions.
Despite the surging torrent of dimensions, it still stood firm.
And if you look closely, you can see countless thunder dragons roaring on the surface of the sword box.
Purple, blood, cyan, gold and other kinds of lightning flashes.
The sword box was like falling into a sea of ​​thunder, washed away by billions of divine thunders.
This scene alone is shocking.
The backs of countless creatures are filled with cold sweat.
As for the ghosts that could be seen everywhere in the underworld, now they only dare to huddle in the corner and tremble.
After all, Leiben is the manifestation of the supreme yang of heaven and earth, not to mention that this is high-dimensional thunder, and the restraint of yin and evil has reached the extreme.
Even the tiniest bit of lightning is enough to destroy these ghosts.
So they can only retreat according to their own instincts.
On the other side, the sword box was still in the boundless sea of ​​thunder.
Time seemed to stand still at this moment.
The rolling thunder light was still bombarding the sword box.
Just as Sun Bing was thinking about when this dimensional catastrophe would end, the sword box suddenly opened.
Such a change immediately made him frown slightly, and his heart sank to the bottom.
After all, those high-dimensional thunders outside are a disaster that Qingping Sword cannot withstand at this time.
When he was extremely worried, Qingping Sword flew out directly.
Immediately afterwards, he swam in the high-dimensional thunder sea in full view of everyone.
